[P2] Resolve the missing regression evidence

Rule 5, **“A bug fix starts with a failing test,”** remains unmet. This corrects a user-visible lifecycle claim, but the diff adds no tests and the description supplies no failing-before/passing-after evidence. Existing stop-failure tests assert permission and timeout hints, so reverting this correction would leave them passing. Please return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) to agree on minimal regression evidence or obtain an explicit maintainer-approved exception for this documentation correction under rule 9.
